verdict.rationale: Firstbase sells registered-agent service online in all 50 states at $299 per state per year, and its onboarding flow says it will change your registered agent in your incorporation state. Nothing in the evidence shows the founder receiving the exact agent name and street address, or receiving them the same day for their own formation or change filing. Firstbase instead describes filing on the customer's behalf. Missing for 10: documented disclosure of the agent name and street address to the customer, same-day turnaround, support for self-filed formation or change filings, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can buy registered-agent service online and get the exact agent name and street address my formation or change filing needs the same day

citations.quote: Registered Agent available in all 50 states
